en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, elegant neoclassical building on a corner square. The structure has four stories, pilasters, many rectangular windows, and a central entrance with a small balcony above it. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the open square in front of the building. The printed caption below the image reads "PALAZZO BANCA D'ITALIA - TRENTO."
